description: Plan ID. A 7 digit integer. It refers to an optimization plan.
Plan week. Week in which the plan was active. Year-week number in yyyyww fromat.
Department number. A double digit integer. It refers to a department.
Plan created date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
Out Of Stock timestamp in yyyy-mm-dd HH:MM:SS UTC format.
Input Home Office (HO) recommended retail price.
Mardown spend. Value of markdown inventory at markdown price.
Value of markdown inventory at markdown prior price.
Plan starting on-hands quantity (units) (total for the entire plan duration).
Plan ending on-hands quantity (units) (total for the entire plan duration).
Plan sales quantity (units) (total for the entire plan duration).
Plan starting on-hands quantity (adjusted with upstream inventory) (total for the entire plan duration).
